title: Square
summary: Square is a point-of-sale and online commerce platform for merchants selling in store and online. Connect your Square account to sync your item catalog, inventory, orders, and store locations, and to send fulfillment and inventory updates back to Square.
body_markdown: Square is a point-of-sale and online commerce platform for merchants selling in store and online. Connect your Square account to sync your item catalog, inventory, orders, and store locations, and to send fulfillment and inventory updates back to Square.
